component.name: Paperman
component.summary: Electronic filing cabinet: scan, print, stack, arrange

description.p: Paperman scans paper straight into stacks of pages, filed in folders, which can be viewed, arranged, printed and searched.

ul.li: Quickly scan and file paper, from sheet-fed document scanners
Read and write PaperPort .max files, and PDF
Stack, arrange and name scanned paper
Search the text of scanned pages
